#: OpenLamina's dashboard (scripts/dashboard.json, ini/dashboard.ini, --manifest tests/unit/data/manifest_basic.json, --jobs 2): a long press of the left menu button opens it over the game, which gets DashboardActivated and whose actions read inactive while it's open; the overlay app draws its dashboard overlay at the panel's pose in its own frames; 'Quit game' gives the game VREvent_Quit and closes it; the game's own dashboard overlay is published for its tab, and its other overlays aren't Each program also finds the other's dashboard overlay by its key (FindOverlay) and reads it through that handle: the game sees the overlay app's shown, 1 m wide, at the panel; the overlay app reads the game's key, and changes its width (read back at once, applied by the game) and posts it an event (PostOverlayEvent), which the game polls on it. The game reads the panel itself through system.systemui: shown, at the panel, and not to be changed. The overlay app's dashboard overlay gets OverlayShown when the dashboard shows it and OverlayHidden when it closes, and IsOverlayVisible and GetTransformForOverlayCoordinates answer as the dashboard shows it.
